prompt_text: Who is the best health insurance broker in Kansas City to help me pick a plan?
answer_verbatim:
There isn’t one objectively “best” broker, but **BBS Insurance** looks like a strong place to start for individual or family coverage: it’s an independent Kansas City–area agency that says it compares Marketplace and private plans, checks subsidy eligibility, and serves both sides of the state line. Its site reports a 5.0 Google rating from 90 reviews. You can reach them at **816-205-4664** or visit [bbs-insurance.com](https://bbs-insurance.com/).

**Apollo Health Insurance** is another option; it says it serves individuals and families across the metro and compares plans from multiple carriers. See [apollo-insurance.com](https://apollo-insurance.com/).

Before enrolling, ask the broker to confirm that your preferred doctors, hospitals, and prescriptions are covered—and whether the plan is ACA-compliant and eligible for subsidies. Broker services are often free to you, but ask how the broker is compensated and which insurers they can offer.
